verdict.rationale: Hightouch's public REST API is versioned by URL path: the published OpenAPI spec pins servers to https://api.hightouch.com/api/v1, and the API guide uses /api/v1 endpoints. Nothing in the evidence documents a versioning policy, deprecation timelines, sunset notices or a changelog, so only half the story is shown, and only by implication. Missing for 10: documented API versioning policy, documented deprecation/sunset policy, API changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration.
